name: SmoothScalp / ReinforcedSmoothScalp / Scalp (EMA5 hi/lo + stoch)
author: berlinguyinca collection (author not stated in file)
indicators: EMA5(high/low/close), STOCHF(5,3,0,3,0), ADX, CCI(20), RSI(14), MFI, BB(20,2)
entry_long: open<EMA5(low) AND ADX>30 AND MFI<30 AND fastk<30 AND fastd<30 AND fastk crosses above fastd AND CCI<-150
exit: (open>=EMA5(high) OR fastk/fastd crosses above 70) AND CCI>150
filters: Reinforced adds resampled SMA50<close, plus hyperopt gates
implementation_notes: Three variants merged (see DEDUPE_NOTES). Scalp = same w/o MFI/CCI; entries ADX>30, fast<30. Freqtrade note: minimal_roi/stoploss are part of the published strategy; ROI exits are time-since-entry based. Source file is the sole spec; no independent verification of results.
